target.definition: Total number of passengers carried by public transport in Spain (urban, interurban and special/discretionary combined) during August 2026, as first reported in INE's provisional Passenger Transport Statistics.

inputs.name: annual_passengers_2025
inputs.description: Total public transport passengers in Spain in calendar year 2025 (all modes combined)

provenance.rationale: INE ETP monthly totals in recent years run ~450-500 million passengers/month, implying ~5.5-6 billion/year

inputs.name: august_share_of_year
inputs.description: Fraction of annual public transport passengers carried in August (holiday month, lower commuting)

provenance.rationale: August is below the 1/12 = 0.083 average due to reduced commuting, partly offset by tourism

inputs.name: annual_growth_factor
inputs.description: Year-on-year growth factor of public transport passengers from 2025 to 2026

provenance.rationale: Recent Spanish public transport ridership has grown a few percent per year

inputs.name: monthly_passengers_2025
inputs.description: Average monthly public transport passengers in Spain in 2025

provenance.rationale: Annual total divided by 12

inputs.name: august_seasonality_index
inputs.description: Ratio of August passengers to the average month

provenance.rationale: August typically runs slightly below the annual average month

inputs.name: population_spain
inputs.description: Population of Spain in 2026

provenance.rationale: Spain's population is around 48-49 million and slowly rising

inputs.name: trips_per_person_per_day
inputs.description: Average public transport trips per person per day in August (residents plus tourists, averaged over population)

provenance.rationale: Roughly 140 public transport trips per person per year, with August tourism raising the per-capita rate

inputs.name: days_in_august
inputs.description: Number of days in August

provenance.rationale: Calendar fact

inputs.name: tourist_visitors_august
inputs.description: Foreign and domestic tourists present in Spain during August 2026

provenance.rationale: Spain receives ~10 million foreign tourists in August plus domestic holidaymakers

inputs.name: tourist_trips_per_day
inputs.description: Public transport trips per tourist per day in August

provenance.rationale: Tourists use buses, metro and coaches moderately while on holiday

inputs.name: resident_trips_per_day
inputs.description: Public transport trips per resident per day in August

provenance.rationale: Lower than the annual average because of holidays and reduced commuting

inputs.name: avg_trip_distance
inputs.description: Average distance of a public transport trip in Spain

provenance.rationale: Blend of short urban trips and longer interurban and coach trips

inputs.name: passenger_km_per_year
inputs.description: Total public transport passenger-kilometres in Spain per year

provenance.rationale: Roughly 5-6 billion trips times ~10-12 km average distance

paths.description: Scale last year's annual total by growth and the August share of the year
Average month times August seasonality index times growth
Residents plus tourists times daily trip rates times days in August

problems: path p2: dimension mismatch: the formula gives count per time (s**-1), but the target needs a pure number, a count or a share (dimensionless). The formula has one 'per time' more than the target; inputs with a time unit in this path: monthly_passengers_2025 ('passengers/month'). If the target is a total over a period, multiply by an input whose unit is a length of time: the period itself (for example days_in_period with unit 'day'), or period_length = 1 with unit 'year' when a share of the year then picks the part you need. A share, or a ratio such as 'days/year', has no time unit and does not cancel it.
